column1: # Context exclusions for entity_candidates.py. Kept apart from entity_aliases.tsv:
# an alias row says "this spelling names X"; a row here says "in THIS context this token is not a name".
# Nothing is excluded globally: a row applies only when its context regex matches around the token,
# and only to the weak shape rules listed in `rules`. A mention with any other rule (e.g. $MLN as a
# cashtag) keeps that rule and stays confirmed. Excluded detections are stored with status=excluded.
#   surface   token after NFKC+casefold, whole word
#   rules     comma-separated rules this row may suppress (caps, title_name, camel_name, phrase_head, bracket_symbol)
#   context   regex checked in a +-60 char window; {w} stands for the token itself (case-insensitive)
#   reason    short class: unit / timezone / month / report_label / auction_verb
#   basis     where it was seen in this snapshot
